newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline hit by crude selloff, buyers retreat.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline hit by crude selloff, buyers retreat.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were hit by a sharp, late selloff in the crude market, with swamps tumbling but physical barge prices holding up better as wet trade came to a close for the day.
Nov swaps late in the day were down $4 at $220/$221 after earlier trading twice at $228 and at $227.50, traders said. Dec fell similarly to about $207.50/$209.50.

Eurograde barges were heard offered at about $227 fob ARA, down only $1 from Wednesday but off from trades done earlier at $232. Regular unleaded was offered at $220, down from an earlier trade done at $225.
